summary: The First Den is a forest world centered on Spawn and the owner's home, extending through farms, Mirror Tarn, Garden and Market districts, a royal city/castle and a hilltop village. Authored scenes combine seeded terrain, reusable procedural builders, activities, crowds and wildlife; the player uses WoW-style movement, bending combat and Wynx the rideable/following gryphon. The wunix identity is presented as an animated red fox, and shared mesh kits now give forest trees and many hand-built scene models softer foliage lighting.
places: places/main/config.yaml - the single seeded forest place: terrain, water, site marks, material bands, fog and environment
places/main/cells/x0z0.scene - Spawn, The First Den/home, farms, sky-dragon manager and many authored landmarks/activities
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene - lake/creek approaches and wolf-pack encounter manager
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene - Ember Roost, folk and town-square crowd roots
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene - hilltop village and village-crowd root
places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene - Garden Market district and garden-crowd root
places/main/cells/objects.scene - separately authored/shared placed objects across the main place
roots: templates/player.js#player - player entity behavior stack for movement, locomotion, home/travel/activity, gryphon mount, bending and fox presentation
templates/camera.js#camera - WoW-style camera root; body heading and look orbit with riding-aware third-person presentation
places/main/config.yaml - main place terrain, site marks, water, material and environment root
places/main/cells/x0z-1.scene#wolf-pack - local wolf encounter manager and den population
places/main/cells/x0z1.scene#folk-crowd / #town-crowd - district and square population managers
places/main/cells/x1z1.scene#village-crowd and places/main/cells/x-1z1.scene#garden-crowd - village and Garden Market population managers
shared: scripts/forest-terrain.js - heightAt(ctx)/materialAt(ctx) contract used by terrain and terrain-relative placements
scripts/lib/wow-steer.js - camera-relative WoW steering shared by player and camera/locomotion behavior
scripts/lib/data/gryphon.js + scripts/lib/wynx-kit.js - Wynx tuning, modes, animation/audio and FX shared by mount and follower
scripts/lib/data/npc-models.yml - model/rig-height registry reused by folk, town, garden and village crowd managers
scripts/lib/road-solid.js + scripts/lib/solid-kit.js - solid and collider construction shared by road/site builders
scripts/lib/home-interaction.js + scripts/lib/data/home-feel.js - player press targeting and home-interaction tuning
scripts/lib/data/bending.js + scripts/lib/fct.js - bending/combat rules and combat-text event helper used by bender, wolf-pack and HUD
scripts/gen/soften.js + scripts/gen/tree-kit.js - foliage-normal wrapper for dozens of procedural builders; tree mesh/ramp/spine kit used by forest and valley trees
notableExports: scripts/player.js - onSpawn(ctx), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); movement, identity presentation and gryphon ground-riding clearance
scripts/camera.js - finiteNumber, onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/humanoid-locomotion.js - ride(), onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt)
scripts/gryphon-mount.js - onInput(ctx,input), update(ctx,dt); scripts/wynx.js - updateSchedule, update(ctx,dt); scripts/lib/wynx-kit.js - FEATHERS, DUST, setMode, yawOf
scripts/fox-companion.js - onSpawn(ctx), update(ctx,dt); wunix fox model, travel-facing, locomotion clips and airborne foxfire
scripts/forest-terrain.js - GROUND, SITES, LAKE, heightAt(ctx), materialAt(ctx); scripts/gen/soften.js - softened(geometry)
scripts/gen/tree-kit.js - hex, ramp, mesher, spine; scripts/gen/forest-plant.js - geometry(ctx), collider(ctx)
scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - crowd update managers; scripts/sky-dragons.js - onSpawn, launch, roar, ears, update
scripts/bender.js - zap, maxHp, land, aoe, release, onSpawn, onInput, update; scripts/wolf-pack.js - updateSchedule, aggroRadius, update; scripts/ui.js - onMount, onDestroy, default
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/data/player.yml - movement intent, velocity, jump, flight, rope and camera mode; flyBoost scales flight speed; movement scratch/cached intent in ctx.session
scripts/camera.js - camera.state.heading is body WoW heading; camera.state.off is separate orbit/look offset; publishes native orbit and collision distances

scripts/gryphon-mount.js + scripts/wynx.js - mount behavior owns player riding/flyBoost transitions; Wynx owns unmounted follow position, yaw and animation mode; per-player mount scratch in ctx.session.gry
scripts/fox-companion.js - wunix-only fox appearance, animation/facing/effect selection; fox timing and travel samples in ctx.session.foxState
scripts/bender.js + scripts/lib/data/bending.js - bending level/XP, HP/chi, stance/spells, cooldowns, target, combat and cast/channel state; tick scratch in ctx.session
scripts/wolf-pack.js - wild-wolf HP, level, threat, target, status, death/respawn and combat; publishes summaries to place.state.wolves
scripts/folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js - each manager owns its roster's NPC spawn/route/pose and scheduling; scratch in ctx.session
scripts/sky-dragons.js - manager owns scheduled flight requests/live dragon IDs and flight poses; dragon entities carry path/time state
flows: templates/player.js behavior stack -> player.js input/update -> player movement/flying state; humanoid-locomotion reads casting/riding and supplies the corresponding pose
player Z/mount action -> gryphon-mount.js finds or spawns tagged Wynx, seats/dismounts rider and updates riding/flyBoost; wynx.js follows owner when unmounted
player movement/flying + player.state.riding='gryphon' -> player.js ground saddle-height raycast/terrain clearance and hop; camera.js detects riding for third-person orbit
gryphon-mount.js / wynx.js mode changes -> lib/wynx-kit.js setMode -> anim/gryphon.yml clips, spatial audio and speed FX; lib/data/gryphon.js supplies movement/follow tuning
templates/player.js -> fox-companion.js; wunix detection dresses entity with scripts/gen/animal-fox.js and fox-companion selects anim/fox.yml clips from travel speed/airborne state
player inputs -> scripts/bender.js -> player bending/cast state and scheduled release/land/aoe handlers -> wild-wolf effects and damage
bender damage/status/threat writes -> scripts/wolf-pack.js scheduled update -> combat, death/respawn and player rewards; summaries flow through place.state.wolves to bend-hud via ui.js
scripts/lib/fct.js fct() -> uiEvent named fct -> scripts/ui.js onMount -> bend-hud text pool renders hit/heal/XP feedback
places/main/config.yaml marks/seed -> forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt -> terrain, water and material bands; site marks coordinate terrain clearing/grading with structures
folk/town/garden/village crowd roots -> managers read roster YAML and npc-models.yml -> spawned model/rig or procedural actor, movement and pose
x0z0.scene sky-dragons root -> scheduled launch/live-ID updates -> moving dragon entities; sky-dragons:launch ears requests launches

generator geometry(ctx) -> softened wrapper captures authored faces and returns rebuilt normals (unless custom normals/UVs); forest-plant/valley-tree use tree-kit mesher for explicit canopy/trunk normals
behaviorFamilies: scripts/gen/tree-kit.js + forest-plant.js + valley-tree.js - seeded forest broadleaf, sapling, shrub and valley trees vary by kind, leaf palette, dimensions and LOD; bent trunks, root flares and puff canopies use gradient lighting
scripts/gen/soften.js - reused by dozens of scripts/gen builders; foliage-color faces get rounded mass normals while authored smooth/flat faces and broad flat surfaces retain their lighting
scripts/gen/cob-house.js + cob-furnish.js - multilevel tree-centered home/furnishing varies by item, dimensions, palette and seed
scripts/gen/road-bridge.js + scripts/lib/road-solid.js; town-lane.js + town-rampart.js - bridge and town-road/boundary geometry vary by dimensions, route, gaps and seed
scripts/gen/town-square.js + town-kit/town-link.js - civic pieces, lamps, directional posts and named links vary by kind, layout and placed text
scripts/gen/farm-crops.js, farm-fence.js, farm-props.js - crop rows, orchard props, pens, barns/mill and scarecrows vary by crop, points, style, item and seed
folk-crowd.js, garden-crowd.js, town-crowd.js, village-crowd.js + npc-models.yml - model-backed NPC bodies/poses with procedural fallback and per-district routes/wardrobe

scripts/gryphon-mount.js + wynx.js + gen/gryphon.js + anim/gryphon.yml; fox-companion.js + gen/animal-fox.js + anim/fox.yml - companion locomotion varies by rider/travel state; fox has idle, walk, trot, gallop and leap clips
probableOrphans: scripts/flat-terrain.js - no current place config selects it; main uses forest-terrain
scripts/jade-dragon.js - no scene behavior row attaches this actor script; scripts/gen/jade-dragon.js geometry may still be used
scripts/gen/garden-garb.js and scripts/gen/garden-wear.js - earlier map found no current scene/template references
scripts/gen/royal-cathedral.js and scripts/gen/royal-statue.js - earlier map found no current scene attachments
migrationNotes: forest-terrain heightAt/materialAt take a context object; main river is at sea level y=0, ground around y=0.5, and Spawn clearing near (0,-3); coordinate material IDs, terrain marks and decoration bindings.
Gryphon origin is rider feet; GRY.paws sets saddle/ground clearance. player.js terrain raycast/height, GRY.paws, mount geometry and unmounted Wynx ground-follow behavior are coupled.
Wynx lifecycle is keyed by player.state.riding='gryphon' and tagged wynx entity ownership; keep mount state, companion owner/ridden flags, camera detection and locomotion ride pose aligned.

npc-models.yml supplies model heights for roster NPCs, with procedural fallback; model-backed poses use humanoid-locomotion, so keep height/layout and animation-channel assumptions aligned across crowd managers.

softened(geometry) returns explicit normals after intercepting tri/quad/color/smooth/flat; preserve builder-authored UV/custom-normal results and note that broad flat foliage-color faces are intentionally not puffed. tree-kit mesher returns normals alongside ctx-emitted geometry.

Sky dragons track manager state.live IDs rather than world-wide queries; Mirror Tarn is centered (82,78), water level 0.3/depth 2.6, with shore and Three Squares routes described in main config, town-links.json and scene signs.
